b5e98464__Skoda-Superb-25-years-of-comfo.alt: Škoda Superb: 25 years of comfort, space and technical excellence
b5e98464__Skoda-Superb-25-years-of-comfo.caption: The revival of the Superb name marked Škoda’s return to the mid-size segment after more than five decades. The first modern-generation Superb offered outstanding interior space and a high level of comfort, laying the foundations for the qualities that continue to define the model today.

The current generation of the Škoda Superb builds on the legacy of its predecessors while taking comfort, safety and digitalisation to a new level. It features a redesigned interior with Škoda Smart Dials and a broad range of petrol, diesel, mild-hybrid and plug-in hybrid powertrains.

The third generation represented a major technological leap, introducing advanced connectivity, a comprehensive range of driver-assistance systems and a more expressive design language. In 2019, the Superb became the first production Škoda model available with a plug-in hybrid powertrain.

The second-generation Superb expanded the range with the practical Combi estate body style and further strengthened the model’s appeal to families and fleet customers. Its popularity was driven by its generous space, versatility and wide choice of powertrains.

The update introduces several firsts for the segment, a refined design, new powertrain options and additional comfort features.

6b386aae__260331_A-Czech-German-success-.alt: A Czech-German success story: 35 years of Škoda Auto as part of the Volkswagen Group
6b386aae__260331_A-Czech-German-success-.caption: The agreement signed on 28 March 1991, which brought Škoda Auto into the Volkswagen Group, marked the beginning of a new era for the Mladá Boleslav-based carmaker. Backed by major investments, shared technologies and coordinated development, Škoda has grown into a successful global player active in around 100 markets worldwide.

6b386aae__260312-Skoda-Auto-hit-another-.alt: Škoda Auto hit another record year in 2025; will double its all-electric portfolio in 2026
6b386aae__260312-Skoda-Auto-hit-another-.caption: Škoda Auto Board of Management

94490c59__2026-IIHF-Ice-Hockey-World-Cha.alt: 2026 IIHF Ice Hockey World Championship: Roman Josi wins Most Valuable Player trophy created by Škoda Design
94490c59__2026-IIHF-Ice-Hockey-World-Cha.caption: The trophy was presented during the closing ceremony by Maren Gräf, Škoda Auto Board Member for People & Culture.

f8ff4932__260427_Award-Milan-Design-Week.alt: Škoda Auto celebrates successful Milan Design Week with strong visitor interest and Fuorisalone Award recognition as highest-rated installation
f8ff4932__260427_Award-Milan-Design-Week.caption: Škoda Auto’s brand exhibition at Milan Design Week 2026 attracted nearly 60,000 visitors between 21 and 26 April. Hosted at the historic Palazzo del Senato, the installation combined physical and digital elements to present Škoda’s current design approach in an immersive setting.

728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.alt: Škoda Octavia turns 30: Three decades of a brand icon
728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.caption: Škoda Auto is marking the 30th anniversary of the modern-generation Octavia, which entered production on 3 September 1996. Since then, the model has played a central role in the development of the Mladá Boleslav-based carmaker following its integration into the Volkswagen Group, combining quality and practicality with proven Volkswagen Group technology.

86741f96__260227_Skoda-opens-new-battery.alt: Škoda opens new battery systems assembly hall, becoming Volkswagen Group’s largest BEV battery system manufacturer and an essential pillar of its electrification strategy
86741f96__260227_Skoda-opens-new-battery.caption: The opening ceremony was attended by Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš, Minister of Industry and Trade Karel Havlíček, Chair of the Škoda Supervisory Board, Member of the Board of Management of Volkswagen Group and Volkswagen Brand CEO Thomas Schäfer, along with Škoda Auto CEO Klaus Zellmer, Škoda Auto Board Member for Production Andreas Dick and Jaroslav Povšík, Chairman of the KOVO trade union.

b5e98464__2_124c8aed.jpg.alt: Škoda Auto and National Theatre extend partnership until at least 2029

728314ef__260825-Skoda-Auto-supports-UCI.alt: Škoda Auto supports UCI Mountain Bike World Championshipsas official partner for second year running
728314ef__260825-Skoda-Auto-supports-UCI.caption: The event comprises five disciplines: cross-country Olympic, cross-country short track, cross-country team relay, downhill and E-mountain bike cross-country. More than 800 riders from over 50 countries will compete for 17 gold medals and the coveted rainbow jersey.

b5e98464__3_f5061b7b.jpg.alt: Škoda Auto and National Theatre extend partnership until at least 2029

86741f96__260205_Skoda-Auto-Substantial-.alt: Škoda Auto: Substantial support for the new organ in St Vitus Cathedral at Prague Castle
86741f96__260205_Skoda-Auto-Substantial-.caption: Since 2018, Škoda Auto has played an active role in the exceptional project to build a new organ for St Vitus Cathedral at Prague Castle. The project for the new St Vitus organ symbolically completes – after more than seven centuries – the construction of the Czech Republic’s foremost cultural and spiritual landmark.

9dd7d96c__2_488737fd.jpg.alt: Škoda Auto supports Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift as Official Main Partner for the fifth year

b5e98464__260902_936-km-without-rechargi.alt: 936 km without recharging: Škoda Peaq sets range record for electric seven seater SUV
b5e98464__260902_936-km-without-rechargi.caption: The largest and most spacious SUV in the Škoda portfolio set off on its record attempt from the company’s headquarters in Mladá Boleslav at midday on Tuesday, 25 August. Travelling through Germany and taking breaks to change drivers, rest and eat, the crew reached the Netherlands early on Wednesday morning before completing the journey that afternoon in the seaside resort of Zandvoort.

8b558dfa__260514_Skoda-Auto-celebrates-3.alt: Škoda Auto celebrates 33 years as Official Main Sponsor of the IIHF Ice Hockey World Championship and unveils the Epiq
8b558dfa__260514_Skoda-Auto-celebrates-3.caption: Škoda Auto will be supporting the Ice Hockey World Championship in Switzerland as the Official Main Sponsor for the 33rd time.

b5e98464__260902_936-km-without-rechargi.alt: 936 km without recharging: Škoda Peaq sets range record for electric seven seater SUV
b5e98464__260902_936-km-without-rechargi.caption: Without recharging the traction battery, the seven-seater Škoda Peaq covered 936 km at an average energy consumption of just 9.2 kWh/100 km.

b5e98464__260902_936-km-without-rechargi.alt: 936 km without recharging: Škoda Peaq sets range record for electric seven seater SUV
b5e98464__260902_936-km-without-rechargi.caption: At the wheel of the record-setting vehicle were Škoda Auto employees Marek Jež (left) and Jakub Krs (right). They were also the ones who came up with the idea of testing how far a seven-seater electric vehicle could travel in real-world driving conditions.

b5e98464__Martin-Jahn_4145f266.jpg.alt: Martin Jahn, current Board Member for Sales and Marketing

4397252d__Michael-Kerschensteiner_d25b84.alt: Škoda Auto announces new Chief Procurement Officer: Michael Kerschensteiner to take the lead

728314ef__260806-Skoda-Peaq-SOP-1_52d035.alt: Škoda Auto launches production of the new Peaq in Mladá Boleslav
728314ef__260806-Skoda-Peaq-SOP-1_52d035.caption: Building electric and combustion-engine vehicles side by side allows Škoda Auto to respond to market demand and disruptions to global supply chains by flexibly adjusting the production mix between Mladá Boleslav and Kvasiny.

9dd7d96c__260701-Skoda-Auto-marks-23-yea.alt: Škoda Auto marks 23 years as Tour de France main partner; new Škoda Peaq to serve as ‘Red Car’
9dd7d96c__260701-Skoda-Auto-marks-23-yea.caption: Tour de France Race Director Christian Prudhomme will use the all-new, range-topping electric Škoda Peaq as his Red Car at this year’s race.

94490c59__260622_World-premiere-of-the-a.alt: World premiere of the all-new Škoda Peaq: livestream from France
94490c59__260622_World-premiere-of-the-a.caption: Tomorrow, Škoda Auto will present its all-new electric flagship, the Škoda Peaq. For fans of the brand worldwide, the company will stream the reveal live from 18:25 CEST on 23 June.

728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.alt: Škoda Octavia turns 30: Three decades of a brand icon
728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.caption: The decision to revive the historic Octavia name – originally used for a model produced between 1959 and 1971 – was taken during the development of a new vehicle. Work began in 1992, one year after Škoda Auto had joined the Volkswagen Group. Access to the Group’s technology supported the development of a practical car styled by Dirk van Braeckel, then Škoda’s Head of Design.

94490c59__260618_Skoda-offers-a-first-gl.alt: Škoda offers a first glimpse of the interior concept of its electric seven-seater Peaq
94490c59__260618_Skoda-offers-a-first-gl.caption: The Škoda Peaq offers spacious interior with generous room across up to three rows of seats, while the open, flowing design enhances the sense of airiness.

94490c59__260615_Skoda-Peaq-Comprehensiv.alt: Škoda Peaq: Comprehensive testing in extreme conditions
94490c59__260615_Skoda-Peaq-Comprehensiv.caption: In addition to Europe, the prototypes were tested in Africa and North America. Extensive virtual testing using high-performance computing supported the simulation of a wide range of scenarios.

94490c59__260604-Skoda-Peaq-front_d2956f.alt: Škoda presents exterior sketches of its all-new electric seven-seater Peaq
94490c59__260604-Skoda-Peaq-front_d2956f.caption: Škoda Auto has revealed exterior sketches of its all-new electric seven-seater Peaq. At the front, the slender T-shaped headlights, gloss-black Tech-Deck Face and connecting element between them form a distinctive, frame-like loop motif.

728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.alt: Škoda Octavia turns 30: Three decades of a brand icon
728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.caption: Today, the fourth generation of this best-selling model is produced in Mladá Boleslav, Kvasiny and Kostanay, Kazakhstan. Almost 7.9 million units have been produced over the past three decades.

728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.alt: Škoda Octavia turns 30: Three decades of a brand icon
728314ef__Skoda-Octavia-turns-30-Three-d.caption: The Octavia remains a popular choice among private and business customers across international markets and has received numerous prestigious international accolades, including multiple Best Cars awards and the Golden Steering Wheel.

728314ef__260825-Skoda-Auto-supports-UCI.alt: Škoda Auto supports UCI Mountain Bike World Championships as official partner for second year running
728314ef__260825-Skoda-Auto-supports-UCI.caption: Škoda Auto is showcasing its full range of all-electric models – the new flagship Peaq, the Epiq SUV crossover, the Enyaq and the Elroq – along the courses and in the fan zones. The carmaker has also designed the ‘hot seat’ for the current downhill leader.

728314ef__260820_Skoda-receives-Red-Dot-.alt: Škoda receives Red Dot Award for its Vision App concept
Škoda receives Red Dot Award for its Vision App concept

728314ef__260818_Skoda-Auto-unveils-upda.alt: Škoda Auto unveils updated Slavia in India
728314ef__260818_Skoda-Auto-unveils-upda.caption: Alongside the Kylaq and Kushaq SUVs, the Slavia forms part of Škoda Auto’s localised ‘made in India, for India’ model portfolio. Beyond its domestic market, the Slavia is also exported to growth markets including Vietnam, the Middle East and Africa, underlining the role of India as a second strong pillar for Škoda Auto outside Europe and its importance to the company’s internationalisation strategy.

728314ef__260818_Skoda-Auto-unveils-upda.alt: Škoda Auto unveils updated Slavia in India
728314ef__260818_Skoda-Auto-unveils-upda.caption: The updated Slavia features a refreshed look and dynamic design language, along with new technologies that further enhance comfort and convenience. These include segment-first offerings such as a Rear Seat Massage function, as well as enhanced connectivity through a new-generation infotainment system featuring an AI Companion powered by Google Cloud’s Automotive AI Agent.

728314ef__260818_Skoda-Auto-unveils-upda.alt: Škoda Auto unveils updated Slavia in India
728314ef__260818_Skoda-Auto-unveils-upda.caption: The popular Monte Carlo trim is available from launch with dual-tone exterior colours, characteristic black exterior accents, Monte Carlo badging and visual cues that pay homage to Škoda’s rally heritage.

728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.alt: Simply Clever for summer: smart Škoda features that make every trip easier
728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.caption: The ventilated Phone Box helps prevent phones from overheating during wireless charging and is available depending on the model. In the Kodiaq and Peaq, the driver and front passenger can charge their phones wirelessly at the same time.

728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.alt: Simply Clever for summer: smart Škoda features that make every trip easier
728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.caption: The umbrella stored in the driver’s door – and, in some models, also in the front passenger door – remains one of Škoda’s best-known Simply Clever features. It is kept securely stowed and within easy reach.

728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.alt: Simply Clever for summer: smart Škoda features that make every trip easier
728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.caption: A waste bin in the door pocket helps keep the interior tidy.

728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.alt: Simply Clever for summer: smart Škoda features that make every trip easier
728314ef__260817_Simply-Clever-for-summe.caption: The net programme, bag hooks and Cargo elements help keep items securely in place in the boot. Bags can be hung from hooks, while smaller items can be held in nets or secured with Cargo elements.

8a8e8b11__750_21_SKODA_Header_eprofese_I.caption: eMobility is the future and ŠKODA AUTO is fully committed to its development. But who are the people working on batteries, charging systems and infrastructure at the Czech carmaker? Let’s get to know them.

0d078354__H3.jpg.caption: More emotive design, better aerodynamics and therefore improved range on a single charge. That’s what the new all-electric ŠKODA ENYAQ COUPÉ iV offers. Take a peek beneath its camouflage.

551ee036__Navrhova-plocha-2-1.jpg.caption: What does the all-electric ŠKODA ENYAQ iV sound like? Listen to its original sound and find out how it was designed with the help of composers and music producers.

99b69136__751_20_Header_Best_of_2-1.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA ENYAQ iV and the sporty OCTAVIA RS iV. But also battery production, the MEB platform, ŠKODA Powerpass, and charging with the help of flywheels. Take a look back at some electrifying moments of 2020.

41927b7c__enyaq_iv_072-copy.jpg.caption: ŠKODA has presented its much-awaited fully electric SUV, the ENYAQ iV. The new model offers a long range and a huge choice of practical features and versions to suit every customer.

02450074__myty_header_eng.png.caption: For most motorists, electric cars are still a novelty. There are a lot of myths out there, but most of people’s concerns are unnecessary.

b513d8ad__5_V2-1.jpg.alt: A BEHIND-THE-SCENES LOOK: MASKED ENYAQ iV IN IRELAND
b513d8ad__5_V2-1.jpg.caption: The first journalists have already been given access to ŠKODA’s ENYAQ iV electric SUV in Ireland. The new car’s lines were disguised by camouflage, but there was no hiding its character and driving properties. Read on to find out what organising this kind of event involves.

dcca9cce__header-skoda-training-centre-k.alt: Learning how to breathe life into a hybrid car
dcca9cce__header-skoda-training-centre-k.caption: All workers, even if they don’t work with hybrid cars, need to go through safety training, otherwise known as conditioning or electro-safety.

dcca9cce__header-laura-digital-assistant.caption: ŠKODA Digital Assistant Laura, which is available for the Amundsen infotainment system, is a new advanced voice control system, which is also able to understand natural speech. It can be activated simply by saying “Okay, Laura” – there’s no longer any need to press a button or perform any other kind of action.

eb3ee638__header_energie.jpg.caption: Electric car use will substantially improve the air quality in cities. For this to apply beyond cities, coal-fired power plants should not be heavily involved in the production of the electricity required for electric car batteries. Experts earnestly seeking new sustainable sources to supplement hydro, solar and wind power plants.

d0e125b6__Vision-iV-Chassis-front-header.caption: Electric vehicle (EV) is a sweeping term that, in its broadest sense, encompasses any car that uses electricity for propulsion.

d82697d6__header.jpg.caption: The automotive industry is on the cusp of the Electrical Age. The powering of cars with electricity is nothing new, having previously cropped up elsewhere in history. Much like other alternative drives. This is because designers have been grappling with the question of what makes for the best form of drive for at least 250 years now.

2c683f75__best-of-header-V4.jpg.alt: My Life, My Car: Eleven lives, eleven cars
2c683f75__best-of-header-V4.jpg.caption: No two people’s destinies are the same. Some have a clearly mapped path, others will find life springing surprises on them, but the story of everyone’s life is engaging. Especially when there’s a car in it. ŠKODA Storyboard tried to tell you some of them in 2018.

1156249a__History-Connectivity-header.jp.caption: Cars have long been so much more than four wheels and a steering wheel. Just about everyone now takes the connection between their phone and car for granted. How did connectivity first see the light of day in ŠKODAs? And what does the future hold for us?

dcbf5323__from-radio-to-internet-header..alt: From radio to the Internet - the history of audio systems
dcbf5323__from-radio-to-internet-header..caption: All you need do these days for a bit of company in your car is press a button on the dashboard. Popular music, the spoken word, news, traffic information – we take all these for granted these days. Infotainment systems and their predecessors, car radios, have developed apace.

0a44313c__blinkers-indicators-skoda.jpg.caption: The way drivers indicate that they are turning, another of those seemingly very simple things, has evolved considerably over the past hundred years. We have picked out some of the exhibits at the ŠKODA MUSEUM to show you how we started out with mechanical arrows and ended up with modern direction indicators.

59668533__header_volanty-1-e154953289254.caption: Although autonomous cars of the future may have no steering wheel at all, at present the steering wheel is still an indispensable part of the dashboard and does not seem to be changing dramatically. Yet steering wheels have gone through interesting development over the more than hundred years of their existence. Let’s have a look at what has changed since the beginning of their history.

0a44313c__startovani-header.jpg.alt: Engine starting systems: Decades of transformation
0a44313c__startovani-header.jpg.caption: You probably know that the very first engines were started with a crank handle, while in the latest vehicles a dashboard button does the same job. But what happened in-between? Did you know that cars could be started with a crank handle as late as 1960? Let’s tour the history of engine starting systems by taking a look at some of the exhibits at the ŠKODA MUSEUM in Mladá Boleslav.

2b5e8e76__744_22_SKODA_Header_Garde_I.jp.caption: On 30 April 1982, production of the ŠKODA GARDE moved from Kvasiny to Bratislava. Today this coupé is a highly prized classic, as the constantly rising prices show. Find out about its history.

b252e223__741_22_SKODA_Header_130-MONTE-.caption: On 28 January 1977, ŠKODA 130 RS cars claimed the top two places in the Monte Carlo Rally up to 1,300 cm3 category. Relive this famous victory with us and take a look around the legendary rally car’s interior.

a3fe3cc6__745_22_SKODA_Header_crash_test.caption: Crash testing has been done in the Czech Republic (and previously Czechoslovakia) for over 50 years now. Needless to say, ŠKODA was the pioneer. See how it all began.

3a8e9b07__747_22_SKODA_Header_Taxi-1907_.alt: HOW TAXIS GAVE PRAGUE THE FEEL OF A BIG CITY
3a8e9b07__747_22_SKODA_Header_Taxi-1907_.caption: 115 years ago, Prague became the first city in the Austro-Hungarian Empire to launch a taxi service, thanks to the LAURIN & KLEMENT motor works. It wasn’t long before Vienna and even Paris saw the company’s reliable cars enrolled in taxi duties.

a6941c03__748_21_SKODA_Header_Octavia-19.alt: ŠKODA OCTAVIA: 25 YEARS AT THE TOP
a6941c03__748_21_SKODA_Header_Octavia-19.caption: The first days of September 1996 marked the beginning of the successful era of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA, which has now lasted for a quarter of a century. The car was officially unveiled on 1 September, and two days later the modern factory in Mladá Boleslav started mass production of the new car.

627f7a34__746_22_SKODA_Header_crash_test.alt: HOW LAURIN & KLEMENT MANUFACTURED CARS AND DRIVERS
627f7a34__746_22_SKODA_Header_crash_test.caption: In 1907 the first drivers trained by a driving school set up by the LAURIN & KLEMENT factory in Mladá Boleslav hit the roads. How did vehicle registration work and how were the first motorists taught and tested at the start of the last century?

a6848d40__746_21_SKODA_Header_Voiturette.alt: A HISTORIC MOMENT: THE FIRST “MOTORISED CART” IS MADE IN MLADÁ BOLESLAV
a6848d40__746_21_SKODA_Header_Voiturette.caption: A one-litre engine, a car with a fabric roof and no windscreen, so the driver is buffeted by the wind and rain but still delights in the experience. That is just how our great-grandfathers felt if they had the good fortune to drive the first automobile from Mladá Boleslav in 1906 – the VOITURETTE A.

e00eee37__741_20_SKODA__skoda_Vyroci_193.alt: HOW THE POPULAR AVOIDED AN ELEPHANT AT THE MONTE CARLO RALLY
e00eee37__741_20_SKODA__skoda_Vyroci_193.caption: 85 years ago a ŠKODA POPULAR Sport roadster set off for the Monte Carlo Rally. The journey across the whole of Europe ended in one of ŠKODA’s greatest motorsport successes of the time.

0d078354__749_21_SKODA_superb.jpg.caption: Twenty years ago, ŠKODA expanded its range to include a mid-range car: an almost five-metre-long sedan with ample space for passengers and luggage and a host of safety features. It was named SUPERB.

a6848d40__746_21_SKODA_Header_OCTAVIA-CO.alt: THE FIRST OCTAVIA COMBI: A HUGE BOOT AND A COMFORTABLE BED
a6848d40__746_21_SKODA_Header_OCTAVIA-CO.caption: The OCTAVIA is ŠKODA’s current bestseller. The present-day estate version continues the tradition begun by its predecessor, which started production 60 years ago in the summer of 1961. One amazing feature of the first OCTAVIA COMBI was that it converted into a comfortable bedroom.

942a4fe2__100-years-logo-header-cz-en.jp.caption: In 2018, the Czech Republic is commemorating 100 years of modern statehood. ŠKODA, as a carmaker deeply rooted in Czech history, is marking this centenary with a specially designed logo

1156249a__parts-headerimage_V3.jpg.caption: Clutch, alternator, crankshaft, fuel injectors. All drivers are sure to have heard these words. But do you really know what they look like and how they work?

d60cda40__Storyboard-cover-_17__9b58fe7c.alt: Making driving easier. How cruise control works

34a6b1a8__H1_KDQ_NG_013_high_5c4187fc.we.alt: They save lives. How airbags work

24e98ef0__SCL_NG_158_1121_H1_22c97982.jp.alt: A good view and protection. What’s important in car glass?
24e98ef0__SCL_NG_158_1121_H1_22c97982.jp.caption: Windows and glass are an indispensable part of modern cars, and few people give them much thought. But they have a number of functions and the technology involved can be fascinating. Take a look.

dcbf5323__hero_V2.jpg.alt: ŠKODA through the eyes of a mechanic
dcbf5323__hero_V2.jpg.caption: The bonnet conceals a world of remarkable devices and parts made of steel, aluminium, and other materials that engineers everywhere have been fine-tuning for more than a century. Thanks to modern electronic systems, vehicles today can do amazing things; their design has also made them much safer than the cars of the past.

aeb09f6d__enq_ng_110-copy_57578f10.jpg.alt: Tips for getting the best sound
aeb09f6d__enq_ng_110-copy_57578f10.jpg.caption: Is there any point in adjusting the radio settings according to the number of people in the car? Is it better to hook up your phone using a cable or via Bluetooth? How should you set up the equaliser? ŠKODA’s audio experts are happy to share their top tips so you get the best out of your car’s sound system.

a3fe3cc6__745_22_SKODA_bezklicove_system.alt: The approach of the keyless age
a3fe3cc6__745_22_SKODA_bezklicove_system.caption: How have people protected their property against theft since time immemorial? With locks. And cars are no different. See how this little contraption has developed in the past few years – from classic old locks to today’s keyless systems.

639089b4__742_22_SKODA_repro_header.jpg.alt: How are cars set up for music and phone calls?
639089b4__742_22_SKODA_repro_header.jpg.caption: Are the audio systems in ŠKODA cars tested with sensitive acoustic measurement technology or with a trained ear? Both, of course. And more besides. Find out what the people in charge of setting up your car’s sound system do to make it sound great.

7ad55d82__752_21_SKODA_Header_Anteny_III.alt: This is your car, can you hear me?
7ad55d82__752_21_SKODA_Header_Anteny_III.caption: The car’s classic rod antenna for radio reception is almost a thing of the past. But did you know that modern cars have a number of hidden antennas? Find out where they are.

0d078354__749_21_SKODA_Header_tlumice_II.alt: Shock absorbers: it’s a hard life
0d078354__749_21_SKODA_Header_tlumice_II.caption: Shock absorbers are a vital part of cars that we don’t even notice. We simply expect them to provide comfort, safety and the enjoyment of a more dynamic ride. How do shock absorbers do that?

551ee036__skoda_sterace_header-1.jpg.alt: WINDSCREEN WIPERS AND SPRAYS DESERVE CARE AND ATTENTION
551ee036__skoda_sterace_header-1.jpg.caption: Without windscreen wipers, you wouldn’t be able to see a thing in the rain or snow. But do you know how to take care of them?

168ad7ed__89_karoq_sportline_4x4_57417b1.alt: 4x4 for greater safety and for driving pleasure
168ad7ed__89_karoq_sportline_4x4_57417b1.caption: All-wheel drive is very popular among Škoda drivers, and the company offers it in a number of models and versions. Take a look at how it works and what it’s good for.

639089b4__742_22_SKODA_brzdy_header_IV.j.alt: How do brakes learn how to brake
639089b4__742_22_SKODA_brzdy_header_IV.j.caption: The brakes are a car’s most important safety feature. We take them for granted, but they have to cope with incredibly tough demands and challenges. Take a closer look at how they are developed and how they work.

e00eee37__ENQ_NG_127.jpg.alt: Keeping your front and rear windscreens clear
e00eee37__ENQ_NG_127.jpg.caption: They’ve been with us for over a hundred years and have hardly changed. They are still rubber blades that sweep water off a glass surface. But did you know that windscreen wipers were invented by a woman?

df14cfed__The-new-Skoda-Enyaq-Enyaq-Coup.alt: Unveiling the new Škoda Enyaq: World Premiere this Wednesday
df14cfed__The-new-Skoda-Enyaq-Enyaq-Coup.caption: Škoda Auto’s new all-electric bestseller will be unveiled on the brand’s official YouTube channel on Wednesday, 8 January 2025 at 10:00 CET.

0c1f0ef5__240222_200000-production-miles.alt: Škoda’s Enyaq family surpasses 200,000 production milestone
0c1f0ef5__240222_200000-production-miles.caption: Škoda Auto has reached a significant milestone in advancing its e-mobility strategy, marking the production of 200,000 units of the Enyaq and Enyaq Coupé models. The jubilee car is a white Enyaq Coupé Sportline, which rolled off the production line on 16 February.

0c1f0ef5__240206_First-sketches-of-refre.alt: Škoda releases first sketches of the refreshed Octavia
0c1f0ef5__240206_First-sketches-of-refre.caption: Now in its fourth generation, the Octavia is set to receive its facelift four years after the start of production. This latest iteration introduces a refined exterior with new headlights, redesigned bumpers, and an updated Škoda grille The model will continue to be available as both a hatchback and Combi estate.

1baa5686__240626_Skodas-voice-assistant-.alt: Škoda’s voice assistant Laura now enhanced with ChatGPT capabilities
1baa5686__240626_Skodas-voice-assistant-.caption: The functionality of Škoda’s voice assistant Laura has been significantly expanded thanks to the integration of Chat Pro from technology partner Cerence Inc.. Alongside previously available sources of information, the Chat Pro function is now directly connected to the advanced AI tool ChatGPT to answer questions beyond the scope of Laura’s original knowledge.

5e830ea9__240404-MySkoda-app-1_1894a001..alt: New MyŠkoda app combining several new functions in one applicationfor enhanced customer experience
5e830ea9__240404-MySkoda-app-1_1894a001..caption: The updated MyŠkoda app offers convenient vehicle access along with a host of new and improved features.

0769a03a__Skoda-Auto-produces-one-millio.alt: Škoda Auto produces one millionth battery system for Volkswagen Group vehicles
0769a03a__Skoda-Auto-produces-one-millio.caption: Škoda Auto produced its one-millionth battery system at its main plant in Mladá Boleslav. The carmaker has been manufacturing high-voltage traction batteries since 2019. These batteries, with capacities ranging from 55 to 91 kWh (net capacity 52 to 86 kWh), are installed in the Škoda Enyaq and Škoda Elroq as well as other Volkswagen Group brands, such as Volkswagen, SEAT/CUPRA and Audi.

0c1f0ef5__240205_New-training-facilities.alt: Škoda Auto opens new training facility in Kvasiny
0c1f0ef5__240205_New-training-facilities.caption: Representatives from Škoda Auto and the KOVO Union opened the new training facilities, 300 employees a year will soon be learning how to handle robots in production. There are currently 1,169 robots in use at the Kvasiny plant.

cbfef660__251127_Skoda-Auto-produces-100.caption: As the first model to feature Škoda’s Modern Solid design language, the compact SUV has proven popular with customers and experts alike. In its first year on the market, it has become one of the most sought-after electric vehicles in Europe and is now the second best-selling model in its segment.

a818f128__250214-30-years-since-the-foun.caption: Today, this state-of-the-art, highly flexible production line adapts to changing customer demands by building the Octavia with efficient combustion engines alongside the all-electric Enyaq family and the Elroq

df14cfed__Skoda-Elroq-Czech-carmaker-lau.caption: The Škoda Elroq is the brand’s first fully electric model in the strategically important compact SUV segment and Škoda’s first production model to adopt the new Modern Solid design language.

b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.caption: The FC model had a front engine with SV valve control and a 2,438 cm³ displacement. The top speed was up to 90 km/h. The wheelbase was 2,448 mm; the track width was 1,300 mm front and rear. The two rigid axles were suspended by leaf springs. Laurin & Klement produced 19 vehicles of the FC type in total.

a1ca90ce__01-LK-RKM.jpg.caption: Compared to the original 1913 specification with the Knight engine, the Laurin & Klement RK/M from 1921 was distinguished by a four-cylinder with overhead valves, 4.7-litre displacement and a power output of 55 kW (75 hp). It reached speeds of up to 125 km/h.

a6848d40__210628-SKODA-SPORT-10.jpg.caption: The racing car had a weight-optimised chassis from the Škoda 1101. Due to the vehicle’s low height, the powertrain was repositioned, and the central tube was shortened by 400 mm, while the fork of the skeleton frame was lengthened at the front.

c5eeff22__02.jpg.alt: Škoda 1100 OHC (1957): The beautiful dream of Le Mans
c5eeff22__02.jpg.caption: Thanks to the use of glass fibre-reinforced plastic (GRP), the 3,880 mm long, 1,430 mm wide and 964 mm tall racing car weighed just 583 kilograms.

c5eeff22__05.jpg.alt: Škoda 1100 OHC (1957): The beautiful dream of Le Mans
c5eeff22__05.jpg.caption: To achieve the best possible handling, the load was optimally distributed over both axles. The clutch, five-speed gearbox and transfer case were installed in the rear, where they formed a cohesive assembly unit.

a6848d40__210628-SKODA-SPORT-11.jpg.caption: The car was given a low, open body that was made by hand from sheet aluminium.

a6848d40__210628-SKODA-SPORT-13.jpg.caption: With the racing fuel common at the time – a mixture of petrol, ethanol and acetone – the Škoda Sport reached a top speed of 140 km/h.

a6848d40__210628-SKODA-SPORT-12.jpg.caption: The fuel tank was placed behind the two seats and the fuel was supplied by an electric pump.

c5eeff22__01.jpg.alt: Škoda 1100 OHC (1957): The beautiful dream of Le Mans
c5eeff22__01.jpg.caption: Development of the two-seater sports car began in the spring of 1956 with one clear objective – the racer was to take up where the first and only Škoda works car had left off in the prestigious 24-hour race at Le Mans (1950).

c5eeff22__210729-SKODA-F3-type-992-1966-.caption: In the 1966 season, the monoposto racing car for Formula 3 was powered by a water-cooled in-line four-cylinder with a displacement of 998 cm³ with an output of 66 kW (90 hp) at 8000 rpm. It was fitted with a Weber carburettor and a manual four-speed gearbox. Unladen, it weighed 405 kg and could reach speeds of up to 210 km/h.

c5eeff22__03.jpg.alt: Škoda 1100 OHC (1957): The beautiful dream of Le Mans
c5eeff22__03.jpg.caption: The steering, which was as precise as it was direct, was controlled by a three-spoke steering wheel that could be removed to make it easier to get into the car.

a1ca90ce__210430-SKODA-OCTAVIA-TOURING-S.caption: The Škoda Octavia Touring Sport (TS) secured numerous victories at international rallies in the early 1960s, continuing the motorsport tradition of the car manufacturer from Mladá Boleslav.
The car achieved speeds of up to 130 km/h. The four wheels were individually suspended from the central tubular frame.
The second to fourth gear of the four-speed gearbox were synchronised; the gear stick was positioned in the centre tunnel.

c5eeff22__210729-SKODA-F3-type-992-1966-.caption: The unladen weight of the Škoda F3 was just under 420 kilograms, with the front axle accounting for 41.5% and the rear, including the engine, for 58.5%.

The first Škoda 992 single seater was completed in February 1964. It had a tubular steel trellis frame and independent suspension, with trapezoidal half-axles at the front and five-link suspension at the rear.

8a8e8b11__01-SKODA-SPIDER-B5.jpg.caption: The Škoda Spider B5 racing car prototype is powered by the Škoda 720 OHC water-cooled in-line four-cylinder engine with a displacement of 1,498 cm³ and an output of 110 kW (150 hp) at 7,000 rpm via a manual five-speed gearbox; its kerb weight is 630 kg, and the top speed is 220 km/h.

a6941c03__SKODA-200-RS-Rallye-3.jpg.caption: The 200 RS made its debut at the IDA Rally in what was then Czechoslovakia in May 1974, followed by the Barum Rally with two cars and the Škoda Rally (pictured) in Mladá Boleslav, where the three red-and-white-painted cars competed alongside each other on 1 June 1974.

a6941c03__SKODA-200-RS-Sedivy-Janecek-4..caption: Pictured here is the Škoda 200 RS with the Kvasiny crew of Jiří Šedivý - Jiří Janeček after winning the Rally Šumava 1975. The main role in the development of the bodywork was played by Ing. Jiří Šedivý (right), engineer and driver in one person. One of the most experienced co-drivers, Jiří Janeček (left), formed a crew with Jiří Šedivý from 1972 to 1980, and worked for the factory team…

8a8e8b11__211025-SKODA-130-RS-1975-1.jpg.caption: The Škoda 130 RS got off to a very successful start, both in rallying (pictured) and on the circuits. It opened its first rally season in 1976, and just one year later, it took class victory in the Monte Carlo Rally, finishing 12th overall (driver team Blahna/Hlávka).

8a8e8b11__211025-SKODA-130-RS-1975-3.jpg.caption: The greatest strength of the Czechoslovak coupé, however, was its handling; its light and well-balanced design helped drivers not only around the bends but also on straights, in jumps and when they pushed the accelerator to the limit and literally had to fight against the laws of physics.

0d078354__210906-SKODA-130-LR-3.jpg.caption: The Škoda 130 LR debuted in 1985 and aspired to build on the successes of its predecessor, the 130 RS.

0d078354__210906-SKODA-130-LR-1.jpg.alt: Škoda 130 LR (1984): Last motorsport model from Mladá Boleslav with rear-mounted engine
0d078354__210906-SKODA-130-LR-1.jpg.caption: With its rear engine and drivetrain, the Škoda 130 LR had an unconventional design compared to competitors’ models.

8a8e8b11__211025-SKODA-130-RS-1975-2.jpg.caption: The Škoda 130 RS not only enjoys a definitive place in rallying but also in the history of the European Touring Car Championship. The brand from Mladá Boleslav completed the full season in this prestigious series for the first time in 1978. One year later, the Škoda 130 RS achieved second place in the overall standings, and in 1980, third place behind Audi and BMW, as well as first place…

cc3f5752__SKODA-FELICIA-KIT-CAR-1995-2.j.caption: The entire body skeleton of the Škoda Felicia Kit Car as well as the roof, doors, bonnet and windows were derived from the production model. The only differences being the wider mudguards to accommodate larger wheels.

cc3f5752__SKODA-FELICIA-KIT-CAR-1995-1.j.caption: In 1995, the Škoda Motorsport team entered a total of 24 rallies, four of which were part of the world championship. Achieving third place in Formula 2 came as a surprise.

cc3f5752__SKODA-FELICIA-KIT-CAR-1995-3.j.caption: The McPherson front axle was freely adjustable, and all set-ups were tested beforehand during road trials. The rear axle, which was reinforced, was based on the one used in the Škoda Pick-Up.

7ad55d82__211203-Skoda-Fabia-WRC-2003-1..caption: The Škoda Motorsport works team continued its involvement in the top category of the World Rally Championship with the Škoda Fabia WRC, which was unveiled in 2003.

cc3f5752__SKODA-FELICIA-KIT-CAR-1995-5.j.caption: The Škoda Felicia Kit Car with 1.6-litre engine had an output of 172 hp and achieved 100 km/h in 6 seconds.

7ad55d82__211203-Skoda-Fabia-WRC-2003-3..caption: 24 units of the Škoda Fabia WRC were produced in total.

cc3f5752__211125_SKODA-OCTAVIA-WRC-1999-.caption: Several drivers from the international rally elite have driven the Škoda Octavia WRC over the years. In addition to Armin Schwarz and the Czech stars Pavel Sibera and Emil Triner, the line-up also includes Bruno Thiry, Luis Climent, Roman Kresta, Jan Kopecký, Gabriel Pozzo, Toni Gardemeister, Kenneth Eriksson, Didier Auriol, Mattias Kahle and Stig Blomqvist.

7ad55d82__211208-SKODA-FABIA-S2000-2008-.caption: The Škoda Fabia S2000 was developed according to the rules of the new Super 2000 category, which stipulated a naturally aspirated two-litre engine with an output of 280 hp, four-wheel drive and minimal electronics.

cc3f5752__211125_SKODA-OCTAVIA-WRC-1999-.caption: The Škoda Octavia WRC has secured a firm place in the history of Škoda Motorsport as well as enhancing the brand’s image: it achieved victories in special stages, clinched podium finishes (Armin Schwarz, 3rd place overall in the 2001 Safari Rally) and proved its reliability countless times on the international rally tracks.

7ad55d82__SKODA-FABIA-R5.jpg.caption: After the FIA World Championship debut in Portugal early in 2015, the Škoda Fabia R5 continued the success story of its predecessor. Škoda Motorsport factory drivers won the WRC2/WRC2 Pro category in 2016 (Esapekka Lappi/FIN), 2017 (Pontus Tidemand/SWE), 2018 (Jan Kopecký/CZE) and 2019 (Kalle Rovanperä/FIN)

7ad55d82__211203-Skoda-Fabia-WRC-2003-2..caption: Its 300 hp engine, 600 Nm of torque and all-wheel drive made it a powerful competitor in the international rally scene. The power was transmitted to all four wheels via a sequential six-speed gearbox and three active differentials.

cc3f5752__211125_SKODA-OCTAVIA-WRC-1999-.alt: Škoda Octavia WRC (1999): Entering the highest class of international rallying
cc3f5752__211125_SKODA-OCTAVIA-WRC-1999-.caption: The factory team competed in the top category of the FIA World Rally Championship for the first time with the Škoda Octavia WRC, unveiled in 1999. With an output of 300 hp, it was the first Škoda to be officially designated a World Rally Car.

7ad55d82__211208-SKODA-FABIA-S2000-2008-.caption: The Škoda Fabia S2000 brought home a total of 50 national and international championship titles.
The S2000 category was mainly geared towards customer sport. At the same time, it offered car manufacturers the opportunity to develop vehicles that were significantly cheaper to run.

8b558dfa__04_Skoda_FabiaRS_Rally2_d2d846.caption: Special livery on this Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 takes inspiration from some of the classic liveries of Škoda Motorsport history and celebrates the 125 year anniversary. The car is being used for showcase purposes at different events.

8b558dfa__03_Skoda_FabiaRS_Rally2_0d3a40.caption: Škoda is celebrating its anniversary with special features for all Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 customer vehicles being sold from 1 January 2026.

8b558dfa__01_Skoda_FabiaRS_Rally2_7cb793.caption: Škoda is celebrating its anniversary with special features for all Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 customer vehicles being sold from 1 January 2026.

8b558dfa__02_Skoda_FabiaRS_Rally2_d26aa4.caption: Škoda Motorsport customers get special features with each Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 delivered as part of the 125 years celebrations. Škoda Motorsport uses a special livery on the Fabia RS Rally2 for different events throughout the year.

b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.alt: Laurin & Klement FC from 1908: St. Petersburg – Moscow long-distance drive
b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.caption: One of the most significant motorsport successes of the fledgeling automobile manufacturer was the Laurin & Klement FC’s victory in the long-distance drive from St. Petersburg to Moscow in 1908.

b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.alt: Laurin & Klement FC from 1908: The first major motor racing successes of automobiles from Mladá Boleslav
b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.caption: It was improvisational skill and wit that enabled Alexander Kolowrat-Krakowsky to win the hill climb in Gaillon, France, in 1908.

b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.alt: Laurin & Klement FC from 1908: The first major motor racing successes of automobiles from Mladá Boleslav
b951fcc1__210331-Laurin-Klement-FC-1908-.caption: Alexander Kolowrat-Krakowsky came from a Bohemian noble family and was an extremely talented racing driver who raised the profile of Laurin & Klement in the highest social circles at that time.

a1ca90ce__03-LaK-RK_Karpatska.jpg.caption: Count Sascha used the Laurin & Klement RK as a private car, but in 1913 and 1914 (pictured) he also competed with it successfully in the Alpine Rally, one of the most popular long-distance races of the time.

a1ca90ce__LaK-S-series-2.jpg.alt: Laurin & Klement S series: The first high-volume model from Mladá Boleslav made its debut 110 years ago
a1ca90ce__LaK-S-series-2.jpg.caption: 110 years ago, Laurin & Klement presented the S series, which quickly became the bestseller of the fledgling company from Mladá Boleslav. By 1924, more than 2,000 customers from Europe and overseas had chosen their dream vehicle from the wide range of open and closed body variants.

8a8e8b11__211025-SKODA-130-RS-1975-5.jpg.caption: The drivetrain of the Škoda 130 RS consisted of a classic, water-cooled four-cylinder engine with OHV valve control, installed behind the rear axle. The first sales version had a power output of 82.8 kW (112.5 hp) at 7,250 rpm, gradually rising to 105 kW (142 hp) at 8,500 rpm as the circuit car developed.

8a8e8b11__211025-SKODA-130-RS-1975-4.jpg.caption: The Škoda 130 RS achieved many outstanding results in international rallies, one highlight being class victory in the 1977 Monte Carlo Rally with the Blahna/Hlávka driver team.

c5eeff22__210729-SKODA-F3-type-992-1966-.caption: Driver Jaroslav Bobek won the Czechoslovak championship with the Škoda F3 in 1966.

5d963a69__SKODA_FABIA_S2000_hall.jpg.caption: In 2009, the ŠKODA FABIA SUPER 2000 took the rally scene by storm. ). In total, the car won 50 national and international titles worldwide, thereby writing the most successful chapter in ŠKODA’s motorsport history – until its successor, the ŠKODA FABIA R5, surpassed it.

cc3f5752__SKODA_FELICIA_Kit_car-RET.jpg.alt: Škoda Felicia Kit Car (1995): The next chapter in an international success story

cc3f5752__SKODA-FELICIA-KIT-CAR-1995-4.j.caption: The 1.6-litre engine was used for the first time in Portugal, where Pavel Sibera finished second among the cars with one driven axle.

a1ca90ce__210430-SKODA-OCTAVIA-TOURING-S.caption: Thanks to a higher compression ratio of 8.4:1, the Octavia TS 1200 presented in January 1962 generated 55 hp at 5,100 rpm. The engine achieved a maximum torque of 86.2 Nm at 3,500 rpm.

cc3f5752__211125_SKODA-OCTAVIA-WRC-1999-.caption: The Škoda Octavia WRC was powered by a turbocharged two-litre engine with five-valve technology. It produced 221 kW (300 hp); the torque was initially 500 Nm at 3,250 rpm, subsequently rising to 600 Nm.

a818f128__250214-30-years-since-the-foun.caption: The ceremony was attended (from left to right) by then Minister of Industry and Trade Vladimír Dlouhý, Czech President Václav Havel, Škoda CEO Ludvík Kalma, and Volkswagen Group Chairman Ferdinand Piëch.

413f7bbc__250918_Skoda-Auto-builds-4-mil.alt: Four million SUVs built, seven model series: Škoda Auto’s broadest SUV line-up to date
413f7bbc__250918_Skoda-Auto-builds-4-mil.caption: The newest addition, the Elroq, is already among Europe’s best-selling electric vehicles, with more than 100,000 orders placed by the end of August.

68b0300a__Skoda-Auto-produces-first-unit.alt: Škoda Auto produces first units of updated Octavia in Kvasiny
68b0300a__Skoda-Auto-produces-first-unit.caption: The first updated Škoda Octavia built at the Kvasiny plant has rolled off the production line. The production of additional units of the brand's bestseller in Kvasiny was made possible thanks to the new-generation Superb now being manufactured at the Volkswagen plant in Bratislava.

a818f128__250227_SOP-of-the-new-Enyaq-1_.alt: Škoda Auto begins production of the new Enyaq and Enyaq Coupé
a818f128__250227_SOP-of-the-new-Enyaq-1_.caption: The successor to Europe’s third best-selling all-electric model series last year has entered production: Škoda Auto has begun assembling the new Enyaq at its main plant in Mladá Boleslav.

1ef83eb0__Skoda-Octavia-Combi-RS-wins-pr.alt: Škoda Octavia Combi RS wins prestigious 2024 Golden Steering Wheel award in the mid-sized car category
1ef83eb0__Skoda-Octavia-Combi-RS-wins-pr.caption: Škoda Auto CEO Klaus Zellmer accepted the award yesterday at the gala in Berlin. This victory marks the Czech car manufacturer’s ninth Golden Steering Wheel win. Source: BILD

68b0300a__Skoda-Auto-produces-first-unit.alt: Škoda Auto produces first units of updated Octavia in Kvasiny
68b0300a__Skoda-Auto-produces-first-unit.caption: The Škoda Octavia received a comprehensive update this spring, solidifying its position as the brand’s bestseller.

d4a0adba__240704_When-driving-fun-meets-.alt: When driving fun meets comfort: Rally ace Oliver Solberg tests the Škoda Octavia RS
d4a0adba__240704_When-driving-fun-meets-.caption: The four cylinder turbo-charged engine of the new Škoda Octavia RS comes from the same family (EA 888) as the engine of Solberg’s Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 he uses in competition.

d4a0adba__240704_When-driving-fun-meets-.alt: When driving fun meets comfort: Rally ace Oliver Solberg tests the Škoda Octavia RS
d4a0adba__240704_When-driving-fun-meets-.caption: Motorsport has been part of Škoda’s DNA for more than 120 years. This heritage is traditionally reflected in the Škoda RS range. And the new Škoda Octavia RS is no exception, as Oliver Solberg confirms. The young rally driver from Sweden took the sportiest Octavia model for an extensive test drive.

d4a0adba__240704_When-driving-fun-meets-.alt: When driving fun meets comfort: Rally ace Oliver Solberg tests the Škoda Octavia RS
d4a0adba__240704_When-driving-fun-meets-.caption: The new Škoda Octavia RS has also taken a step towards a sportier driving experience. The chassis sits 15 millimetres closer to the road, which significantly lowers the car's centre of gravity.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000019.jpg.alt: ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245: sporty, spacious and practical – Press kit
064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000019.jpg.caption: The sides come across as sporty and dynamic, an impression that is underlined by the short overhang at the front.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00001.jpg.caption: The new ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 is the most powerful and most dynamic ŠKODA OCTAVIA in the company´s history.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00002.jpg.caption: The new ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 delivers 180 kW (245 PS) – this is 11 kW (15 PS) more than the previous most powerful variant had to offer.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00003.jpg.caption: The standard, burnished gloss-black alloy wheels are 19 inches in diameter.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00004.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 is available in a choice of four body colours: Corrida Red, Moon White, Magic Black and Steel Grey.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00005.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 6.6 seconds, the top speed is electronically limited to 250 km/h.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00006.jpg.caption: Compared to the ‘normal’ models in the range, the sports chassis lowers the body of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 by 15 mm.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_000010.jpg.caption: Compared to the ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 230, the rear track is 30mm wider.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00007.jpg.caption: The acceleration is particularly impressive. In fifth gear, the ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 with a manual gearbox sprints from 60 to 100 km/h in only 6.4 seconds.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00008.jpg.caption: Features such as the spoiler at the rear of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 are further elements of the car’s emotive and dynamic design.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00009.jpg.caption: In keeping with the rest of the exterior, the trapezoid tailpipe trims are painted in gloss black.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_000011.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 bristles with emotion and dynamism.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_000012.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 bristles with emotion and dynamism.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0002.jpg.caption: Its rear track is 30 mm wider than that of its predecessor, the RS 230.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_000014.jpg.caption: The new ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 is the most powerful and most dynamic ŠKODA OCTAVIA in the company´s history.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_000013.jpg.caption: Compared to the ‘normal’ models in the range, the sports chassis lowers the body of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 by 15 mm.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0001-kopie.jpg.caption: The new ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 delivers 180 kW (245 PS) – this is 11 kW (15 PS) more than the previous most powerful variant had to offer.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0003.jpg.caption: The new ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 delivers 180 kW (245 PS) – this is 11 kW (15 PS) more than the previous most powerful variant had to offer.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0004.jpg.caption: You can choose a 6-speed manual gearbox or a 7-speed, dual-clutch transmission.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0005.jpg.caption: Due to the strikingly sporty note of its sports exhaust system, you can even hear that the ŠKODA OCTAVIA RS 245 is different to other models in the range.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0006.jpg.caption: The compact sports car accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in just 6.6 seconds; its top speed is limited to 250 km/h.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_0001.jpg.caption: The radiator grille and the tailgate both sport the RS logo featuring a gloss-black ‘V’.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000020.jpg.caption: The top speed of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 is electronically limited to 250 km/h.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_0003.jpg.caption: In addition, details such as the roof spoiler on the Combi emphasise the emotive and sporty design.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00001.jpg.caption: The new ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 is the most powerful and most dynamic ŠKODA OCTAVIA in the company’s history .

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_0004.jpg.caption: The exterior mirrors and the trapezoid tailpipes are black.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_0005.jpg.caption: The high-power engine and modern chassis technology including the electronically regulated VAQ limited-slip differential offer the ultimate driving experience.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00002.jpg.caption: The powerful engine and innovative chassis technology, including an electronically regulated VAQ limited-slip differential, offer the ultimate driving experience.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00003.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 features the new face of the brand with particularly sporty details.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00004.jpg.caption: The radiator grille’s vertical slats as well as its frame both come in a gloss-black finish.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00006.jpg.caption: The redesigned headlights with a crystalline look, featuring inspiration from Bohemian glass art, come with full-LED technology and the AFS adaptive front light system as standard.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00005.jpg.caption: The bumper is designed with a particularly bold horizontal line, has broad honeycomb air inlets and contributes to the car’s wide and sculptured impression.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00007.jpg.caption: The fog lights also feature LED technology as well as a crystalline appearance.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_0002.jpg.caption: The slats on the radiator grille and the trim that frames the radiator grille both come in a gloss-black finish.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000012.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 are available in a choice of four body colours: Corrida Red, Moon White, Magic Black and Steel Grey.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00009.jpg.caption: Features such as the roof spoiler on the Combi are further elements of the car’s emotive and sporty design.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000010.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 can also be recognised as a high-performance sportster acoustically thanks to the throaty sound of its exhaust system.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000011.jpg.caption: For the ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245, the roofline gently slopes towards the rear and elegantly merges with the D-pillar.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000013.jpg.caption: Under the bonnet of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA family’s sporty top model beats a 180 kW (245 PS) four-cylinder TSI petrol engine.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000016.jpg.caption: From a standing start the ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 hits the 100 km/h mark in 6.7 seconds.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000014.jpg.caption: The outer units of the full-LED headlights with the AFS adaptive front light system produce the dipped beam, while the full beam is produced by the inner units which taper towards the radiator grille.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_00008.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 is 1,814 mm wide and 1.452 Milimeter height.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000015.jpg.caption: For the transmission, there is a choice of a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed DSG gearbox.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0009.jpg.caption: Safety and entertainment is provided by the new infotainment systems. The capacitive touch displays react to the lightest of touches.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000017.jpg.caption: The tail lights and number plate illumination also feature LED technology as well as a crystalline appearance.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000018.jpg.caption: The ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245’s boot is as high as 610 l (1,740 l with the rear seats folded down).

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_0008.jpg.caption: The steering wheel features red topstitching.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00011.jpg.caption: The front seats bear the RS logo.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_0006.jpg.caption: The predominantly black interior of the ŠKODA OCTAVIA COMBI RS 245 impresses not only with its generous dimensions and great clarity, but also with its high-quality materials.

064a79d0__Oc_RS_245_00010.jpg.caption: Front door sills bear the RS logo.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000021.jpg.caption: The multifunction sports steering wheel with perforated leather matches the car’s dynamic ambience. The radio and telephone (Bluetooth) can be operated using buttons on the steering wheel.

064a79d0__OcC_RS_245_000022.jpg.caption: Performance Mode Select with the Performance Sound Generator function enables individual adjustment of drive, chassis and comfort settings.

971e68b7__Skoda-Octavia-is-the-brands-fi.alt: Škoda Octavia is the brand’s first model with a full hybrid powertrain
971e68b7__Skoda-Octavia-is-the-brands-fi.caption: Škoda Auto continues to expand its broadest-ever powertrain portfolio: the Octavia becomes the brand’s first model to offer a full hybrid powertrain. It is offered with system outputs of 100 kW and 125 kW. The series-parallel hybrid system also enables all-electric driving without the need to charge the traction battery externally.

8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.caption: Škoda Auto has prepared the limited-run Fabia Motorsport Edition to mark 125 years of the brand’s motorsport tradition.

8b558dfa__260504_Skoda_Auto_releases_int.alt: Škoda presents first interior sketches and announces world premiere date of electric Epiq
8b558dfa__260504_Skoda_Auto_releases_int.caption: The Škoda Epiq will play a key role in doubling Škoda’s BEV portfolio in 2026. The world premiere will take place in Zurich at 2 p.m. on Tuesday 19 May 2026.

8b558dfa__260504_Skoda_Auto_releases_int.alt: Škoda presents first interior sketches and announces world premiere date of electric Epiq
8b558dfa__260504_Skoda_Auto_releases_int.caption: Horizontal interior architecture replaces a conventional dashboard, enhancing the sense of space and openness.

8b558dfa__260504_Skoda_Auto_releases_int.alt: Škoda presents first interior sketches and announces world premiere date of electric Epiq
8b558dfa__260504_Skoda_Auto_releases_int.caption: As part of the European Urban Car Family within the Volkswagen Group’s Brand Group Core, the Škoda Epiq will help to make electric mobility accessible to a wider group of customers.

8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.alt: Škoda Fabia Motorsport Edition: limited edition celebrates the 125th anniversary of Škoda Motorsport
8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.caption: The car features a styling package inspired by rallying, with visual elements drawn from the current Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 competition car.

8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.alt: Škoda Fabia Motorsport Edition: limited edition celebrates the 125th anniversary of Škoda Motorsport
8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.caption: At the heart of the Fabia Motorsport Edition is an enhanced 130 kW 1.5 TSI evo2 engine.

f8ff4932__260416_Milan-Design-Week_01d4e.alt: Škoda Auto to present unique brand exhibition at Milan Design Week
f8ff4932__260416_Milan-Design-Week_01d4e.caption: Škoda Auto is returning to Milan Design Week after a successful debut in 2025 to present a unique artistic brand exhibition at Palazzo del Senato. The exhibition and large-scale installations, created by Spanish architect and artist Ricardo Orts, founder of Ulises Studio, draw on the playfulness and curiosity associated with modelling clay – the central motif of the global marketing campaign for the upcoming Škoda Epiq.

94490c59__260608_Production_of_the_new_S.alt: Škoda launches production of the new Epiq in Pamplona, Spain
94490c59__260608_Production_of_the_new_S.caption: The Volkswagen Navarra plant, located on the outskirts of Pamplona in northern Spain, is one of the Group’s key production sites. Its nearly 5,000 employees build more than 1,400 cars a day.

9dd7d96c__Skoda-Auto-introduces-Camp-Mod.alt: Camp Mode in the MyŠkoda app: comfortable overnight stays in electric vehicles
9dd7d96c__Skoda-Auto-introduces-Camp-Mod.caption: Škoda Auto is expanding the capabilities of the MyŠkoda digital ecosystem to include Camp Mode, enabling customers to use their electric vehicle as a comfortable base for overnight stays.

8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.alt: Škoda Fabia Motorsport Edition: limited edition celebrates the 125th anniversary of Škoda Motorsport
8b558dfa__260511_Skoda_Auto_releases_lim.caption: The interior’s exclusivity is underlined by the plaque on the dashboard showing the car’s individual number within the limited run of 125 units, as well as the Škoda Motorsport 125 emblem on the three-spoke sports steering wheel and the woven floor mats.

86741f96__260212_Skoda-adds-AirConsole-S.caption: Škoda Play by 3SS is a central video hub for news and learning content from multiple platforms, tailored to the user and vehicle. Like AirConsole, it is available only when parked.

971e68b7__Skoda-Octavia-is-the-brands-fi.alt: Škoda Octavia is the brand’s first model with a full hybrid powertrain
971e68b7__Skoda-Octavia-is-the-brands-fi.caption: The full hybrid Octavia is available as a hatchback and estate in Selection and Sportline trim levels. Compared with models powered solely by combustion engines, standard equipment additionally includes a 13-inch infotainment display, a 10-inch Virtual Cockpit and a HYBRID badge on the tailgate.

971e68b7__Skoda-Octavia-is-the-brands-fi.alt: Škoda Octavia is the brand’s first model with a full hybrid powertrain
971e68b7__Skoda-Octavia-is-the-brands-fi.caption: The smaller of the two electric motors primarily acts as a generator while also starting the combustion engine. The larger and more powerful traction motor drives the front wheels and recuperates energy during braking. Depending on driving conditions, the system automatically switches between all-electric, series hybrid and parallel hybrid operation to maximise efficiency.

94490c59__260618_Skoda-offers-a-first-gl.caption: The large central touchscreen handles core functions, while key features stay on physical controls—ensuring easy, distraction-free use in line with Škoda’s Simply Clever philosophy.

df14cfed__250117-The-all-new-Superb-Hatc.caption: The Hatch variant of the fourth-generation Superb will soon be released with a plug-in hybrid powertrain to complement the Superb Combi iV. The second-generation plug-in hybrid powertrain combines a four-cylinder 1.5 TSI turbocharged petrol engine, delivering 110 kW (150 hp), with an electric motor.

df14cfed__250117-The-all-new-Superb-Hatc.alt: The all-new Superb Hatch: Plug-in hybrid powertrain available soon
df14cfed__250117-The-all-new-Superb-Hatc.caption: The Superb Hatch iV can be fully recharged from 0 to 100% in 2.5 hours using a domestic wallbox or an AC charging point with a maximum charging rate of 11 kW. For quicker charging, the battery supports DC fast charging at up to 50 kW, allowing it to charge from 10% to 80% in 26 minutes.
